# ContractFixture

`schemas/testing/contract-fixture.json`

An M0 contract fixture's golden (docs/design/m0/11 "M0 exercises real validators"): the invariant it targets, the (outcome, reason) sequence its steps must yield through the real components, and the named mutation that must turn it red. adc dev fixtures --contract runs it; make fixtures-contract checks the mutation.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$`) | The fixture's name: its golden file's name and its registered runner. |
| `invariant` | yes | string (minLength `1`, maxLength `500`) | The invariant the fixture targets, in one sentence. |
| `expected` | yes | array of object ([fields](#fields-of-expected)) (minItems `1`, maxItems `64`) | One (outcome, reason) per step, in order, each a pair a writer may emit (02). A command the component admits, applied or replayed, is empty/completed_clean; a component that returns its own result triple is expected with that triple's outcome and reason. |
| `mutation` | yes | string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]{0,127}$`) | The named mutation (internal/mutation) that must turn the fixture red. |

No other fields are allowed.
